actors.name: Kettlewell Allotment Society Chair
actors.private_context: The chair is stepping down and has not yet identified a successor. They want the society to continue smoothly and hope someone will volunteer.

actors.name: Kettlewell Allotment Society Members (collective)
actors.private_context: The members are aware the chair is stepping down. Some may be interested in the role but are uncertain about the time commitment or whether others will step forward. No member has publicly declared an intention to stand.

shared_context: The Kettlewell Allotment Society holds an annual general meeting in five weeks, at which nominations for chair close. The current chair has announced they are stepping down. Any member may volunteer to stand for chair before the meeting.

starting_events.description: The chair's stepping down is announced to the membership.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that at least one member has formally volunteered to stand for chair (e.g., by submitting a nomination or publicly declaring candidacy). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
